chapter.verse: Ahih hangin ke’n kong cih-inah, innluahpa in sum khempeuh a ukpa ahih hangin a neu lai takin sila tawh a kilamdang kei hi.
A pa thuciamna a hun a tun’ matengin amah in a cingte leh a keemte’ khut nuai-ah a om hi.
Tua mah bangin eite i neu lai takin leitung thungeek khut nuai-ah sila in, i om hi.
A hun a cin’ ciangin eite in tapa’ za i ngah nadingin Thukham khut nuai mite tankhia dingin numei gil sungah hong gai-in, Thukham khut nuaiah a hong suak a Tapa Pasian in a sawl hi.
Tua bangin note in tate na suak uh ahih ciangin,“Abba, Pa,” cisakin a Tapa’ Kha Siangtho eite lungsim sungah Pasian in hong sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin sila hi nawn loin tapa na hi uh hi. Tapa na hih uh leh, Pasian hangin innluahpa zong na hi uh hi.
Ahih hangin note in tua hun lai takin Pasian na theih loh lai takun a pian’ lim in Pasian ahi lo mite’ sila-in na om uh hi.

Tu-in ahih leh, note in Pasian na thei khin uh tham loin, Pasian in note hong theih khit ciangin, thahat lo, nopna hong pia thei lo thungeek lamah, a bang hangin kihei kikin sila kaikik nuam na hi uh hiam?
Note in nite, khate, hunte, kumte na tang ta uh hi!
Note adingin a mawkna-in ka hahkat hi ci-in note thu hangin lunghimawhin ka om hi.
Ute naute aw, keimah in note bang ka hih maninah keimah bangin na hi un ci-in ka hong thuum hi. Keima tungah note in a neukha beek na khial kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in a masa-in pumpi dam lohna hangin note kiangah Lungdamna Thu ka hong hilh na thei uh hi.
Keima sungah a om note thuak ze-etna note in ngaihsun loin, nial loin Pasian’ vantungmi bang ka hi zongin, Khazih Zeisu bang ka hi zongin, na hong sang uh hi.
Tua ahih leh, note lungdamna thupha koi lam tungsak ta na hi uh hiam? Na mittang uh lakhia-in, kei hong pia thei hi le-uh cin nong pia zo ding uh hi ci-in note ading teci ka pang hi.
Tua ahih leh, keimah in thuman thutak note kiangah ka hong gen ciangin note’ gal suak ka hi hiam?
Tua mite in note a kilawmin hahkatin hong zo lo tham loin, note in amaute na zon’ nadingun a pua lamah note hong koih nuam ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin a hoihna zon’na ngahna in nomau tawh ka omkhawm laitak bek hi loin, a tawntung hoihna ahi hi.
Khazih in note sungah kip-a, a om matengin note ading ta suak gimna ka thuak ka ta neute aw,
tu-in note tawh omkhawmin ka kam pauna ka kheel nuam hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nomau hangah ka lungmang hi.
Thukham nuai-ah a om nuamte aw, note in Thukham za lo na hi uh hiam, kei kiangah hong gen un.
Lai Siangtho sungah: “Abraham in tapa nih a nei hi. Khat in sila numei tawh a neih tapa ahi hi, khat in sila hi lo numei tawh a neih tapa ahi hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Sila numei’ tapa in ci-le-sa ngeina bangin a suak hi. Sila lo numei’ tapa ahih leh, thuciamna hangin a suak hi.
Tua thute-ah genteh nadingin a om hi. Tua numeite in thuciamna nih ahi uh hi. Hagar ahi numei khat in Sinai Mual tung pan hong piang, sila suahsak nading thu ahi hi.
Tua Hagar in Arabia gam Sinai Mual hi a, tu-in a om Jerusalem khua tawh kibang hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in a tate tawh sila-in a om hi.
Ahih hangin tung lamah a om Jerusalem khua ahih leh, eite nu ahi, sila numei hi lo numei ahi hi.

Lai Siangtho sungah: “Ta suak ngei lo a ciing numei aw, na lungdam in! Nausuak gimna a thuak ngei lo numei aw, kiko in! Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, pasal a nei numei’ tate sangin, A kipaaikhia numei in ta tamzaw a nei hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Ute naute aw, eite in Isaak bangin kiciamna tawh kipawl tate i hi hi.
Ahih hangin tua lai taka ci-le-sa ngeina bangin a suak ta in Kha Siangtho vangliatna tawh a suak ta pen a bawlsiat mah bangin tu-in zong ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Lai Siangtho in bang ci gen hiam? “Sila-numei a tapa tawh hawlkhia in. Silanu’ tapa in sila lo numei’ tapa tawh innluah khawm thei lo ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ute naute aw, eite in sila-numei’ tate i hi kei hi: sila-lo numei’ tate i hi hi.
